title: On hyperbolic and functional analogues of questions of Grünbaum and Loewner
summary: Myroshnychenko, Tatarko, and Yaskin constructed a body $K$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n \geq 5$, with the property that there is exactly one hyperplane $H$ passing through $c(K)$, the centroid of $K$, such that the centroid of $K\cap H$ coincides with $c(K)$. This construction provided answers to questions of Grünbaum and Loewner for $n\geq 5$, which are still open in dimensions $3$ and $4$. We study analogues of these questions in the settings of hyperbolic space $\mathbb H^n$ and $s$-concave functions on $\mathbb R^n$.
